scripts.format: prettier --write astro.config.mjs eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts src scripts tests *.json README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check astro.config.mjs eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts src scripts tests *.json README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run content:validate
scripts.build: node --env-file=.env ./node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs build && pagefind --site dist --force-language vi && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
